raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misreported the release date of "The Beginning or the End" as June 28, 1957, despite earlier correct evidence (IMDb showing February 19, 1947). This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion that "Hold Back the Night" (1956) was released first, when in fact "The Beginning or the End" (1947) was earlier.
